metadata.basis: Active canonical deployed script configuration, read-only extraction. Not an observation of every live spawn.
metadata.difficultyScale: Configured 1–100 base ratings; no invented difficulty tiers.
metadata.unknownValues: null means not explicitly specified; expressions and ranges are retained as strings.
metadata.inheritance: Only copied base properties are inherited through ID. The parent creation/loot trigger is not run by assumption.
metadata.loot: Death loot, carried equipment and carving resources are separate. Pool selections and Rn chances remain conditional.
metadata.followerSlots: Species slots are listed for completeness. The deployed OptionFlags do not enable the native pet-slot cap.
metadata.lootGrammar: ITEM=selection,quantity,RN; default quantity1. Rn is a one-in-n creation roll. Four-or-more brace tokens are resource/weight pairs; value0 means no item. Two numeric brace tokens are an inclusive range. Conditional branches and nested template rules are not independent guaranteed drops.
metadata.resistances: Stored source properties only. Percentage-based elemental resistance reduction is disabled in the current combat configuration. Native fire-immunity flags are a separate mechanism.
